summary: Re-verify (rework round 2) of F-A fix on real runtime. Fix under test: AlembicCore d49fc05 (ProposalExecutor #inFlight Set + #runWithReentrancyGuard wrapping #executeUpdate/#executeDeprecate in BOTH the sweep path #processExpiredProposal and the signal path #evaluateOnSignal; #onSignal filter + checkAndExecute loop skip in-flight ids) on top of accepted 62f0b4b; AlembicPlugin unchanged 799ceac consumes it via live symlink. Confirmed the fix is in the dist the runtime loads (cache @alembic/core->d49fc05, ProposalExecutor.js has inFlight x6). Method identical to round 1 (real cc bootstrap->stdio MCP, ALEMBIC_HOME sandbox, raw backdated seed, real alembic_status tick fires staging-access-sweep, shared cap=3, 6 ticks + isolated clean-update). VERDICT: PASS. (4) F-A FIXED: qualified UPDATE proposals now reach status=executed with a single clean active->evolving->active cycle and resolution 'patch skipped, reverted to active' — prop-up-ok (main seed) AND prop-up-clean (the exact isolated single-proposal scenario that was 100% reproducibly broken in round 1) both -> executed; ZERO proposals carry an 'evolving -> evolving' resolution (round 1 had it). observing->executed flow correct, still bounded (tick1 processed 3 observing -> 1 executed + 2 rejected). (1)(2)(3)(5)(6) NO REGRESSION: per-tick staging/timeout transitions byte-identical to round 1 (promote 3/3/1 stg-01..07 oldest-first; evo-01/02 recovery trigger=timeout-recovery; dec-01/pnd-01/pnd-02 GC->deprecated; pnd-fresh stays pending; cap bounded; gates: no-usage reject, FP reject, deprecate gate-reject, prop-pend-fresh stays pending while prop-pend-old expired). F-B (deprecate execute reachability / deprecated_by edge, edges=0) confirmed OUT-OF-SCOPE per user ruling A->Design; deprecate gate-reject of an un-decayed recipe is correct, not a failure. Invariants: non-resident (no leaked sandbox process, clean exit, no daemon); isolation (sandbox workspace 2b74bdf3 absent from real ~/.asd, 4 real projects untouched); Test changed NO product code (AlembicCore d49fc05 / AlembicPlugin 799ceac clean). Completion definition met: (4) update->executed + (1)(2)(3)(5)(6) no regression. With F-B deferred to Design, the daemon-less lifecycle/proposal automation is e2e-verified.

Invariants — non-resident (no leaked sandbox runtime process post-run, clean exit); isolation (sandbox 2b74bdf3 absent from real ~/.asd, 4 real projects untouched); Test changed no product code (AlembicCore d49fc05 / AlembicPlugin 799ceac clean)
risks: F-B remains deferred to Design (user ruling A): deprecate-proposal execution + deprecated_by edge are not reachable from seeded state because decayScore isn't preserved through KnowledgeEntry stats canonicalization; confirmed out-of-scope for this requirement, gate-reject is correct behavior.
deprecated_by edge path (knowledge_edges) therefore remains unexercised by e2e; if a future requirement needs it proven, a heavier run with a real DecayDetector pass is required.

Fix scope is re-entrancy-only (no gate/transition-Guard/state-semantics change), verified by no-regression on the 5 other checks; broader concurrency (multiple distinct proposals on one entry) not specifically stressed beyond the seeded set.
